title: Python exhaustive peer lookup can crash or exhaust link receive
description: LinkLayer._find_sender catches failures from peer_lookup but calls peer_lookup_all directly and iterates its mutable/unbounded result. Callback exceptions or malformed return values escape receive(), and oversized lists force unbounded candidate processing/signature work. Snapshot an exact list, fail closed on callback/type errors, enforce MAX_ENTRIES, and cover exception/malformed/oversized results.
